parameters.query:
SET search_path TO hermes_outreach;
SELECT s.id AS send_id, s.campaign, s.lead_id, s.state_id, s.provider_message_id, s.sent_at,
  (SELECT occurred_at FROM outreach_events e
   WHERE e.send_id = s.id AND e.event = 'delivered'
   ORDER BY e.occurred_at ASC LIMIT 1) AS delivered_at,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM outreach_events e
   WHERE e.send_id = s.id AND e.event = 'clicked'
   AND e.occurred_at > now() - interval '2 minutes') AS recent_clicks
FROM outreach_sends s
WHERE ($1::bigint IS NOT NULL AND s.state_id = $1::bigint)
   OR ($2::text IS NOT NULL AND s.provider_message_id = $2)
ORDER BY s.sent_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SET search_path TO hermes_outreach;
UPDATE outreach_state
SET status = CASE
      WHEN $3 = 'bounced' THEN 'bounced'
      WHEN $3 = 'complained' THEN 'suppressed'
      WHEN $3 = 'unsubscribed' THEN 'unsubscribed'
      ELSE status
    END,
    next_send_at = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1 OR lead_id = $2;

parameters.query:
SET search_path TO hermes_outreach;
SELECT os.id AS state_id, os.lead_id, l.email, l.campaign
FROM outreach_state os
JOIN leads l ON l.id = os.lead_id
WHERE lower(l.email) = $1
   OR os.id IN (
     SELECT s.state_id FROM outreach_sends s
     WHERE s.provider_message_id = $2
        OR s.provider_message_id = $3
   )
ORDER BY os.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
